localities.name: Seattle
localities.covers: Work performed inside Seattle city limits. Since 1 January 2025 the same rate applies to every employer regardless of size.

facts.summary: Seattle sets its own minimum wage of $21.30 an hour from 1 January 2026 — the highest of the King County jurisdictions and far above the state floor. Employer size no longer changes the rate.

localities.name: Burien
localities.covers: Work performed inside Burien city limits — but which of two conflicting laws applies is currently before the courts.

facts.summary: Burien has TWO conflicting minimum-wage laws — one passed by the city council and one approved by voters as a ballot measure — and the city has asked King County Superior Court to decide which governs. $21.63 an hour is the reported 2026 figure, but do not rely on it without checking the current state of that case.
